configurations.name: fujie-site
runtimeArgs: import os,functools,http.server; p=int(os.environ.get('PORT','8777')); h=functools.partial(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory='site'); http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer.allow_reuse_address=True; print('serving site on',p,flush=True); http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',p),h).serve_forever()
